description: harness-kit: announce that the plugin loaded and where Claude writes its final report and its commit message draft (removing stale ones, telling Claude it may commit its own work locally with that draft but never protected files and never push, telling Claude to update or list every file, comment, test and document that describes behaviour it changed, warning when HARNESS_KIT_EVAL has turned the Stop hook off, and showing a start-up picture of the branch: its brief and goal, the last check result, the last review verdict, the uncommitted changes and the first lines of the project's state file), block Claude from stopping while the project's checks fail, and while they run past their time limit (the check is stopped at 540 seconds, before this hook's 600, so the gate fails closed; each changed check result is recorded in the local event log), refuse tool calls that would put a secret in the repository, refuse git push, destructive git commands and the person's scripts (land.sh, ship.sh, release.sh, upgrade.sh, approve-protected.sh, approve-brief.sh) outside scratch copies under the OS temp folder, refuse Claude writing a brief's approval (*.brief.approved) with any file tool or shell command outside those copies, refuse a background Bash command that is not wrapped in the time-limit helper (scripts/time-limit.mjs), refuse a deploy while the project's pre-deploy check fails, and keep the harness-kit reviewer read-only
